blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable multi-sensor perception in autonomous vehicles requires accurate calibration between cameras and LiDAR. However, calibration drift is often unavoidable in long-term deployments: vibrations, thermal effects, and minor mechanical shocks may alter the relative pose between sensors, leading to systematic errors in downstream fusion tasks. We propose MiCaDe (Miscalibration Change Detection), an online solution detecting when the extrinsic LiDAR-camera calibration parameters are no longer accurate by means of sequential change detection. MiCaDe requires no calibration targets, or modification of the perception stack, providing low false-alarm rates with negligible computational overhead. Our key insight is that 3D and 2D bounding boxes produced by standard object detectors should remain geometrically consistent under correct calibration. By matching cross-modal detections, we derive geometric consistency metrics that serve as sensitive indicators of extrinsic drift. These metrics are aggregated into fixed-size batches and scored against a reference distribution, producing a likelihood stream that is monitored by a Change Point Model (CPM). Crucially, the CPM accumulates statistical evidence over time, enabling detection of subtle drifts that would otherwise go unnoticed. Experiments on multiple long-sequence datasets and on a real-world dataset with physically induced miscalibration confirm reliable detection under diverse conditions. Code available at: https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MiCaDe.
blocks.zh: 自主车辆中可靠的多传感器感知需要在相机和LiDAR之间精确校准. 然而,在长期部署中,校准漂移往往是不可避免的:振动,热效应,和小机械冲击可能改变传感器之间的相对姿势,导致下游聚变任务发生系统性错误. 我们提议MiCaDe(Miscalibation Change Description),当外部的LiDAR-camera校准参数通过顺序变化检测方式不再准确时,在线解决方案检测. MiCaDe 不需要校准目标,或修改感官堆栈,提供低假警报率和可忽略不计的计算间接费用. 我们的关键见解是,标准物体探测器生产的3D和2D定界箱在正确校准下应保持几何一致. 通过匹配跨模式探测,我们得出了几何一致性指标,作为外向漂移的敏感指标。 这些度量衡被汇总成固定大小的批量,并对照参考分布进行打分,产生由变点模型(CPM)监测的可能性流. 关键是,CPM积累了随时间推移的统计证据,从而能够发现否则会被忽视的微妙漂移。 在多个长序列数据集和物理诱导误判的实时数据集上进行的实验,证实了在各种条件下的可靠检测. 代码见:https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MicaDe。

blocks.en: Reliable perception in autonomous driving relies on accurate fusion between complementary sensors such as cameras and LiDARs, which in turn requires a precise extrinsic calibration . Unfortunately, minor shocks and gradual effects, such as vibrations or temperature changes, can cause calibration drifts that accumulate over time, degrading perception accuracy and compromising navigation safety.
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶中的可靠感知依赖于相机和LiDARs等辅助传感器之间的精确聚变,而这又需要精确的外部校准。 不幸的是,微小的冲击和渐进效应,如振动或温度变化,可造成校准漂移,随着时间的推移而累积,降低感知准确性,损害航行安全.

blocks.en: Detecting when calibration becomes unreliable is therefore critical for long-term autonomous operation. Existing approaches typically formulate miscalibration detection as a frame-level classification problem. They first extract cross-modal cues, such as image edges, depth discontinuities, or learned multimodal features, and then train a classifier to decide whether the sensor pair is calibrated or not [ 4 , 20 ] . While effective, these approaches present several limitations. First, they usually require dedicated training procedures and synthetic calibration perturbations. Second, they operate independently on each frame, making it difficult to distinguish transient detection noise from persistent calibration drift. Third, they often require specific neural networks, introducing additional computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 因此,在校准不可靠时进行检测对长期自主运作至关重要。 现有方法通常将校准错误检测定为帧级分类问题. 它们首先提取跨模式提示,如图像边缘,深度不连续,或学到的多模式特征,然后训练一个分类器来决定传感器对称是否校准[4,20]. 这些办法虽然有效,但有一些局限性。 首先,它们通常需要专门的训练程序和合成校准扰动. 第二,它们在每个框架上独立运行,因此难以区分瞬态探测噪声和持续校准漂移. 第三,它们经常需要特定的神经网络,引入额外的计算间接费用.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce MiCaDe (Miscalibration Change Detection), an online monitoring framework for LiDAR-Camera extrinsic calibration. We formulate calibration monitoring as a sequential change-detection problem. Rather than learning whether a sensor pair is calibrated, we explicitly model the distribution of indicators derived from signals that are already available in modern off-the-shelf perception stacks, and monitor these over time.
Specifically, we exploit the correspondence between 3D LiDAR detections and 2D image detections of the same object. Under correct calibration, the geometric relationship between these detections remains statistically stable over time. When the calibration drifts, we expect a systematic change in the consistency metrics, as illustrated in Figure 1 . We therefore continuously monitor the stream of geometric consistency metrics and detect statistically significant deviations from their nominal behaviour. This approach offers several advantages: it requires no task-specific training, accumulates evidence over time to detect subtle relative displacements of the sensors that may be imperceptible in individual frames, and provides control over the nominal false-alarm rate through the Average Run Length (ARL 0 ) parameter, though this control is only approximate when the monitored signal is not perfectly stationary, as we discuss in Section 5 . To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach that casts miscalibration detection as a sequential change-detection problem, rather than as per-frame supervised classification.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们引入了MiCade(Miscalibation Change Description),这是LiDAR-Camera外部校准的在线监测框架. 我们把校准监测作为一个相继变化探测问题。 与其了解一个传感器配对是否被校准,我们明确地模拟了从现代现成感知堆栈中已有的信号中得出的指标的分布,并随着时间的推移加以监测。
具体地说,我们利用了3D LiDAR探测器和2D图像探测器对同一物体的对应. 在正确的校准下,这些探测器之间的几何关系随着时间的推移在统计学上保持稳定. 如图1所示,当校准漂移时,我们期望对一致性指标进行系统改变。 因此,我们不断监测几何一致性指标流,并发现统计学上明显偏离其名义行为。 这种方法具有若干优点:它不需要针对特定任务的训练,随着时间的推移积累证据来检测单个帧中可能无法识别的感应器的微妙相对转移,并通过平均运行长度(ARL 0 )参数来控制名义上的假警报率,尽管这种控制只有在被监测的信号不完全固定时才大致如此,正如我们在第5节中所讨论的那样。 据我们所知,这是第一个将误判检测作为顺序变化检测问题,而不是按照框架监督分类的方法。

blocks.en: MiCaDe matches 3D and 2D detections, extracts geometric consistency indicators from the resulting correspondences, and aggregates them into fixed-size batches. A reference distribution fit on calibrated sequences is then used to score incoming observations, while a sequential change-detection test monitors their evolution and raises an alarm when a statistically significant distributional shift is detected. Since MiCaDe relies exclusively on detections already produced by the perception stack, it introduces negligible computational overhead and can be readily integrated into existing autonomous driving systems [ 16 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: MiCaDe 匹配3D和2D检测,从产生的函式中提取几何一致性指标,并将其聚合成固定大小的批次. 然后使用符合校准序列的参考分布来评分进取的观测结果,而顺序变化检测测试则监测其演化,并在检测到统计上显著的分布移时发出警报. 由于MiCaDe完全依赖于感知堆栈已经产生的检测,它引入了可忽略不计的计算间接费用,可以随时融入现有的自主驱动系统[16,17].

blocks.en: Our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • Sequential monitoring of calibration consistency: we formulate LiDAR–camera miscalibration detection as a statistical change-detection problem, monitoring a data stream of cross-modal geometric consistency metrics and providing low false-alarm rates. • Lightweight calibration monitoring from standard detections: we show that geometric consistency metrics derived from 2D and 3D object detections already available in modern perception stacks provide effective indicators of calibration drift, without requiring additional sensors, supervision, or retraining. • Real-world evaluation with induced drift: we provide the first public on-road dataset with physically induced miscalibration at a known time, enabling quantitative evaluation under real conditions.
blocks.zh: · 对校准一致性进行连续监测:我们把LiDAR-camera误判检测作为一个统计变化-检测问题,监测跨模式几何一致性指标的数据流,并提供低假警报率。 • 通过标准检测进行的轻量级校准监测:我们显示,从现代感知堆栈中已有的2D和3D物体检测中得出的几何一致性度量,提供了校准漂移的有效指标,而不需要额外的传感器、监督或再培训。 • 实际世界评价与诱发漂移:我们提供第一个公开的路面数据集,在已知时间进行物理诱导误判,从而能够在实际条件下进行定量评价。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Calibration monitoring lies at the intersection of LiDAR-camera calibration and change detection. Existing approaches mainly differ in the signal used to assess cross-modal consistency and in the decision rule adopted to detect calibration failures.
blocks.zh: 校准监测位于LiDAR-camera校准和变化探测的交叉点. 现行办法主要在用于评估跨模式一致性的信号和用于检测校准故障的决定规则上有所不同。

blocks.en: 2.1 Calibration Signals
blocks.zh: 2.1 校准信号

blocks.en: Levinson and Thrun [ 10 ] compare image edges with LiDAR depth discontinuities to identify calibration degradation. More recent methods, instead, employ learned cross-modal representations. Chen et al. [ 4 ] learn a consistency score through contrastive learning using a Siamese architecture applied to RGB images and depth maps obtained by projecting the LiDAR points into the image, while Tahiraj et al. [ 20 ] use modality-specific encoders on RGB images and depth maps to extract calibration-sensitive features.
blocks.zh: Levinson and Thrun [10] 将图像边缘与LiDAR深度不连续进行比较,以识别校准降解. 相反,较新的方法采用了学到的跨模式表述。 陈等. [4] 通过使用适用于RGB图像的暹罗式架构的对比式学习来学习一致性分数和通过将LiDAR点投射到图像中而获得的深度地图,而Tahiraj et al. [20] 在RGB图像和深度地图上使用特定模式编码器来提取校准敏感特性.

blocks.en: In contrast, MiCaDe relies on geometric consistency metrics derived from 2D and 3D object detections. Since object detections are already produced by standard autonomous driving perception stacks, this signal is available with essentially no additional sensing or inference cost.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,MiCaDe依赖于从2D和3D对象检测中衍生出来的几何一致性度量. 由于物体探测器已经通过标准的自主驱动感知堆栈产生,这种信号基本上没有额外的感知或推论成本.

blocks.en: 2.2 Decision Rules for Miscalibration Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 误判检测决定规则

blocks.en: Beyond the monitored signal itself, existing methods differ in how calibration failures are detected. Levinson and Thrun [ 10 ] compare geometric consistency measures against fixed thresholds. Learning-based approaches formulate detection as a supervised binary classification problem, where each frame is independently classified as calibrated or miscalibrated [ 4 , 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了监测到的信号本身之外,现有方法在如何检测校准故障方面有所不同。 Levinson and Thrun [10] 比较与固定阈值的几何一致性度量. 基于学习的方法将检测形成一个被监督的二进制分类问题,其中每个帧被独立地归类为校准或误标[4,20].

blocks.en: While effective for large misalignments, frame-level decision rules suffer from several limitations. These approaches require supervised training or manually selected thresholds, do not accumulate evidence over time, and provide no explicit control over the false-alarm rate. In contrast, MiCaDe formulates calibration monitoring as a sequential change-detection problem, enabling training-free monitoring with a nominally controlled false-alarm rate.
blocks.zh: 虽然对大范围错配有效,但框架一级的决定规则受到若干限制。 这些方法要求进行有监督的培训或人工选定的阈值,不随着时间的推移积累证据,也不对虚假警报率提供明确的控制。 相比之下,MiCaDe则将校准监测作为相继发生的变化检测问题来制定,从而能够以名义上控制的假警报率进行无培训监测.

blocks.en: 2.3 Extrinsic LiDAR-Camera Calibration
blocks.zh: 2.3 外部LiDAR-Camera校准

blocks.en: Extrinsic calibration has been extensively studied as a parameter estimation problem. Classical methods rely on explicit geometric correspondences between LiDAR points and image features [ 2 , 3 , 7 , 11 ] , while learning-based approaches directly regress calibration parameters through deep multimodal architectures [ 8 , 23 , 21 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 外振校准作为一个参数估计问题得到了广泛的研究. 古典方法依赖于LiDAR点与图像特征之间的显式几何对应[2,3,7,11],而基于学习的方法则通过深多模式架构直接递减校准参数[8,23,21,13].

blocks.en: While calibration methods exploit cross-modal correspondences to estimate extrinsic parameters, MiCaDe addresses the complementary, operational problem of deciding when such a correction should be invoked: even an accurate calibration procedure still needs to know when it should be invoked, since running it continuously is neither necessary nor safe, as it may overwrite a valid calibration. MiCaDe acts as a lightweight trigger, after which any compatible calibration module can be invoked to estimate the correction.
blocks.zh: 虽然校准方法利用跨模式的函证来估计外部参数,但MiCaDe解决了决定何时应使用这种校准的补充性操作问题:即使准确的校准程序仍然需要知道何时应使用,因为持续运行既不必要也不安全,因为它可能覆盖有效的校准。 MiCaDe充当轻量级触发器,之后可以引用任何兼容的校准模块来估计校正.

blocks.en: 4 Method: MiCaDe
blocks.zh: 4 方法: MiCade

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Overview of MiCaDe. At each timestep, 3D bounding boxes produced by a LiDAR detector are projected into the image plane and matched with 2D bounding boxes from an RGB detector.

At each timestep t t , using the nominal projection matrix 𝐏 0 {\mathbf{P}}_{0} , each 3D detection in 𝒟 t 3 ​ d \mathcal{D}^{3d}_{t} is projected into the image plane and matched to 2D detections in 𝒟 t 2 ​ d \mathcal{D}^{2d}_{t} via Matching (line 6 ), as detailed in Section 4.1 , and a vector of geometric consistency metrics is computed (line 8 ), as in Section 4.2 .

blocks.en: Matched pairs are appended to a running buffer (line 9 ) and grouped into fixed-size batches (line 11 ). Our intuition is that, under correct calibration, the projection of 3D bounding boxes fluctuates around their matched 2D counterparts with no systematic bias. When the relative camera-LiDAR pose drifts, instead, the projected boxes depart from the 2D detections in a consistent direction, inducing a distributional shift in the metric stream. We therefore adopt a sequential change-detection test (Section 4.3 ) to monitor this stream and raise an alarm when a persistent shift is detected (line 15 ). Since all operations are performed on a small set of bounding box detections, MiCaDe is suitable for continuous onboard monitoring with negligible computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 匹配的对子被附加到运行的缓冲器(9号线)上,并分组成固定大小的批次(11号线). 我们的直觉是,在正确的校准下,三维边框的投影会围绕匹配的二维对等物波动,没有系统性偏差. 当相对相机-LiDAR呈现漂移时,投影盒则从2D检测中向一致方向偏离,诱导在度量流中进行分布性转变. 因此,我们通过一个相继变化检测测试(第4.3节),以监测这一流,并在检测到持续转移时发出警报(第15行)。 由于所有操作都是在一小组边框探测器上进行的,因此MiCaDe适合进行连续的机载监测,其计算间接费用可忽略不计.

blocks.en: Change-point detection. During operations, the stream of likelihoods { l k } \{l_{k}\} is monitored using the non-parametric Change Point Model (CPM) of Ross et al. [ 15 ] , based on the Lepage statistic. The CPM operates online and detects both changes in mean and variance of the monitored process. Moreover, it has two important features: (i) it provides control over the nominal Average Run Length ( A ​ R ​ L 0 ARL_{0} ), i.e., the expected time between false alarms, and (ii) it estimates, after each detection, the most likely change point k ^ \hat{k} , which is converted into the corresponding frame index τ ^ \hat{\tau} . The decision thresholds corresponding to a target A ​ R ​ L 0 ARL_{0} are pre-computed offline on synthetic sequences containing random noise realizations, following [ 15 ] . Unfortunately, ARL 0 control is exact only when the CPM inputs are i.i.d. realizations of ϕ 0 \phi_{0} ; as we show in Section 5 , this assumption holds only approximately in our setting. Thus, the ARL 0 is intended as a hyperparameter that regulates the detection sensitivity.

blocks.en: Computational complexity. MiCaDe operates exclusively on detections already produced by the perception stack and therefore introduces only a lightweight monitoring overhead. Its cost is dominated by the 2D-3D matching stage, a Hungarian assignment problem of complexity O ⁡ ( max ⁡ ( L t , ℓ t ) 3 ) O\!\left(\max(L_{t},\ell_{t})^{3}\right) in the number of LiDAR and image detections L t , ℓ t L_{t},\ell_{t} ; metric computation, batch aggregation, GMM evaluation, and CPM updates all operate on low-dimensional quantities and add negligible overhead. Overall, MiCaDe’s cost scales with the number of detected objects rather than with the image or point-cloud size.
blocks.zh: 计算复杂. MiCaDe完全依靠感知堆栈已经产生的探测器运行,因此只引入了轻量级监测机顶. 其成本以2D-3D配对阶段为主,是匈牙利的复杂任务问题O QQ(最大QQ(L t, l t) 3 )!O\!\左(\max(L_{t},\ell_{t})++3}\右)在LiDAR和图像检测L t,l t L_{t},\ell_{t}; 度量计算,批量汇总,GMM评价,和CPM更新均在低维数量上运行,并添加可忽略不计的间接费用. 总体而言,MiCaDe的成本尺度与检测对象的数量而不是图像或点云大小。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We test MiCaDe on three public autonomous driving datasets corrupted by synthetic perturbations, and on a real-world dataset with a physically induced calibration change.

blocks.en: 5.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.1 执行细节

blocks.en: In our experiments, matches are filtered using a truncation threshold τ t = 0.2 \tau_{t}=0.2 and a distance threshold τ d = 50 \tau_{d}=50 m (Section 4.3 ). Feature vectors extracted from 𝒮 r ​ e ​ f \mathcal{S}_{ref} are grouped using a batch size n = 15 n=15 and used to fit a GMM, whose number of components is selected via the Bayesian Information Criterion. Incoming batches are scored using the fixed GMM and monitored online by the Lepage CPM, which uses A ​ R ​ L 0 = 10000 ARL_{0}=10000 and A ​ R ​ L 0 = 20000 ARL_{0}=20000 . Further implementation and reproducibility details are provided in Section A of the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5.2 Datasets and Synthetic Perturbations
blocks.zh: 5.2 数据集和合成扰动

blocks.en: Synthetic Datasets. We evaluate MiCaDe on three public autonomous driving datasets: KITTI Raw [ 6 ] , ZOD [ 1 ] and ONCE [ 12 ] . As object detectors, we adopt PV-RCNN [ 18 ] and Faster R-CNN [ 14 ] on KITTI Raw, PointPillars [ 9 ] and Faster R-CNN on ZOD, and PointPillars and DDQ [ 22 ] on ONCE. KITTI and ZOD run at 10 Hz while ONCE provides frames at 2 Hz, which we use to convert delay to seconds. We use as reference set 𝒮 r ​ e ​ f \mathcal{S}_{ref} a subset of the detectors’ training sequences, and evaluate on the remaining sequences. Further details on dataset splits are provided in Section A .
blocks.zh: 合成数据集. 我们通过三个公共自主驱动数据集来评估MiCade: KITTI Raw [6],ZOD [1]和ONCE [12]. 作为物体探测器,我们在KITTI Raw上采用PV-RCNN [18] 和更快的R-CNN [14],在ZOD上采用PointPillers [9]和更快的R-CNN,在ONCE上采用PointPillers和DDQ [22]. KITTI和ZOD运行于10赫兹,而ONCE则提供2赫兹的帧,我们用来将延迟转换为秒. 我们使用S r e f \ mathcal{S}_{ref} 探测器训练序列的一个子集作为参考, 关于数据集拆分的进一步详情见A节。

Real-World Dataset. We evaluate MiCaDe on a one-hour sequence from a platform with three RGB cameras and a 128-beam LiDAR (Section 5.6 ). Unlike existing benchmarks, our real-world dataset contains a physically induced calibration change, capturing additional sources of variability.
A known calibration drift is introduced by rotating one camera by approximately 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} , resulting in 2,151 calibrated and 5,234 miscalibrated frames. The first 1,000 calibrated frames are used for 𝒮 r ​ e ​ f \mathcal{S}_{ref} , while the remainder is processed online. Detectors trained on ZOD are used in this setting. The dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

blocks.en: 5.3 Competitors
blocks.zh: 5.3 竞争者

blocks.en: We compare against Tahiraj et al. [ 20 ] , trained using MiCaDe’s reference split and the protocol of [ 20 ] . During evaluation, it flags each frame independently as calibrated or miscalibrated, using both the nominal classification threshold (0.5) and also an adjusted threshold on clean sequences to match MiCaDe’s empirical A ​ R ​ L 0 = 10000 ARL_{0}=10000 , enabling a comparison at matched false-alarm rates. Levinson and Thrun [ 10 ] and Chen et al. [ 4 ] are also related, but lack an official implementation and could not be included.

blocks.en: 5.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.4 评价计量

blocks.en:
We evaluate MiCaDe on clean sequences and on sequences with an abrupt or gradual calibration change. For each perturbed sequence, we consider the first alarm raised at time T T : if T > τ T>\tau , the change is correctly detected with delay | T − τ | |T-\tau| ; if T < τ T<\tau , it is a false positive (FP), excluded from the delay computation; if no detection is raised, it is a false negative (FN), which should not occur with sufficiently long sequences. On clean sequences we compute the empirical A ​ R ​ L 0 ARL_{0} (average time, in seconds, between false alarms) and FP/h (false alarms per hour). On sequences with abrupt or gradual changes: the False Positive Rate (FPR) and False Negative Rate (FNR), as above, together with the mean Detection Delay in seconds. On gradual changes only we also report the angle, in degrees, reached by the ramp at the time of detection.
In the supplementary material, we report the delay distribution’s density and cumulative distribution (Section B.2 ).
We additionally report the AUC, the area under the ROC curve, treating the calibrated and miscalibrated portions of a sequence as the two classes and the monitored signal (log-likelihood for MiCaDe, classification score for Tahiraj et al. ) as the score, computed on sequences with abrupt changes, which measures a signal’s raw discriminative power independently of the monitoring scheme.

blocks.en: 5.5 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.5 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 2 reports results on clean sequences and on sequences with abrupt and gradual calibration changes. We omit A ​ R ​ L 0 = 1000 ARL_{0}=1000 : assuming 2s per batch, it would still allow at least 2 FP/h if respected, too frequent for our target regime. On clean sequences, MiCaDe’s empirical A ​ R ​ L 0 ARL_{0} falls short of the nominal target used to calibrate the Lepage threshold on every dataset, whether measured in seconds or directly in batches. Part of this gap is expected, since the target is nominally defined on the batch index; the persisting shortfall in batch count indicates that the monitored batch-level features are not fully stationary. Raising the operating point from A ​ R ​ L 0 = 10000 ARL_{0}=10000 to A ​ R ​ L 0 = 20000 ARL_{0}=20000 substantially reduces the false-alarm rate at a modest cost in detection delay, and we adopt it as our recommended operating point; reliably estimating even rarer false-alarm rates would require longer clean sequences than available here, as shown by KITTI at A ​ R ​ L 0 = 20000 ARL_{0}=20000 , where no false alarm is observed in clean sequences as these are too short.

blocks.en: Sensitivity to individual miscalibration parameters. Unlike the randomized protocol of Section 5.2 , here we apply a single, deterministic perturbation (one axis, one magnitude) per sequence, evaluating each degree of freedom independently at three fixed magnitudes: 0.0125 0.0125 , 0.025 0.025 , 0.05 0.05 rad for rotations; 0.05 0.05 , 0.1 0.1 , 0.2 0.2 m for translations (per-magnitude results are in Section B.1 ). The perturbation is always injected at frame 100, isolating delay attributable to the perturbed DOF from change-point variability. Table 3 reports FNR, FPR, and delay averaged across magnitudes on ZOD. Rotational drifts are detected faster and more reliably than translational ones, with t y t_{y} the hardest axis due to its weaker influence on the monitored geometric cues compared to the systematic horizontal displacement induced by roll or yaw.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows the evolution of three of the monitored metrics, IoU, displacement magnitude, and direction, together with the detector output; the remaining metrics behave analogously and are reported in full in the supplementary material (Figure 13 ). Following the induced perturbation, all monitored metrics exhibit a clear distributional shift, which propagates to the likelihood stream and causes the CPM statistic to cross the decision threshold after 34 frames, corresponding to only 5 batches in this setting, with no false alarms observed throughout the sequence. These results confirm that MiCaDe successfully distinguishes persistent calibration drift from normal variability, and that the behaviour observed under synthetic perturbations transfers to real operating conditions.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
We presented MiCaDe, a lightweight framework for online LiDAR–camera calibration monitoring based on sequential change detection. By monitoring geometric consistency metrics extracted from standard 2D and 3D object detections, MiCaDe detects persistent calibration drift without supervised training or modifications to the perception stack.
Experiments on KITTI Raw, ZOD, ONCE, and a real-world dataset with physically induced miscalibration demonstrate reliable detection across different sensors and driving conditions, while classifier-based baselines require impractical thresholds to achieve MiCaDe’s false-alarm rate.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了MiCaDe,这是基于顺序变化检测的在线LiDAR-camera校准监测的轻量级框架。 通过监测从标准2D和3D对象检测中提取的几何一致性度量,MiCaDe检测到持续校准漂移,而无需监督训练或修改感知堆栈.
KITTI Raw、ZOD、ONCE的实验和物理诱导误判的现实世界数据集表明,在不同的传感器和驾驶条件中进行可靠的检测,而基于分类的基线则需要不切实际的阈值才能达到MiCaDe的假警报率。

blocks.en: A current limitation is the reliance on successful 3D–2D matching, which may fail in sparse scenes or under severe calibration errors. A second limitation, exposed by the gap between the nominal and empirical A ​ R ​ L 0 ARL_{0} observed in Section 5 , is that the monitored batch-level features do not fully satisfy the i.i.d. assumption underlying the CPM, so its false-alarm control holds only approximately. Future work will investigate alternative change-detection schemes more robust to non-stationary inputs, the integration of automatic recalibration modules triggered by MiCaDe, and whether learned alignment strategies such as AutoAlign [ 5 ] or GraphAlign [ 19 ] can further improve detection power, at the cost of the training-free simplicity targeted in this work.
blocks.zh: 当前的一个限制是依赖于成功的3D–2D匹配,这可能会在稀少的场景中失败或在严重的校准错误下失败. 第二项限制是,第5节中观察到的名义A R L 0 ARL_{0}和实证A R L L 0 ARL_{0}之间的空隙暴露出来,所监测的批量级特性不能完全满足CPM的基本假设,因此其假警报控制只维持大约。 今后的工作将调查其他更强有力的变化探测计划,而不是非固定输入,米卡德启动的自动调整模块的整合,以及AutoAlign [5] 或GraphAlign [19] 等已学习到的调整战略是否能够进一步提高探测能力,而代价是这项工作所选择的免费培训简便。

blocks.en: Appendix A MiCaDe: Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A MiCade: 实施细节

blocks.en: MiCaDe implementation for the experiments described in Section 5 is lightweight and designed for online deployment. For each dataset, the 2D and 3D object detectors are trained on the corresponding training split, while a subset of calibrated sequences is reserved to construct the reference set 𝒮 r ​ e ​ f \mathcal{S}_{ref} used to estimate the nominal behaviour of the monitored features. The detector architectures adopted for each dataset are reported in Section 5.2 of the main paper. We use MMDetection as a framework for training the 2D object detector and MMDetection3D for training the 3D object detector.
blocks.zh: 第5节所述实验的MiCaDE实施是轻量级的,设计用于在线部署. 对于每个数据集,2D和3D对象探测器都接受了相应的训练分裂的培训,同时保留了一组校准序列,用于构建用于估计被监测特征名义行为的参考集S r e f \ mathcal{S}_{ref}. 主要文件第5.2节报告了为每个数据集采用的探测器结构。 我们使用MM探测器作为训练2D物体探测器和MM探测器3D训练3D物体探测器的框架.

blocks.en: Feature vectors extracted from 𝒮 r ​ e ​ f \mathcal{S}_{ref} are accumulated into batches of n = 15 n=15 matched detections and used to fit a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) through the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm. The number of Gaussian components is selected using the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), resulting in 4 components for KITTI Raw and 8 components for both ZOD and ONCE. The resulting GMM remains fixed during deployment.
blocks.zh: 从 S r e f\ mathcal{S}_{ref} 中提取的特性矢量被累积成批次的 n = 15 n = 15 匹配检测,并通过期望-最大化(EM)算法用于匹配高斯混合模型(GMM). 高斯的组件数量采用巴耶斯信息标准(BIC)选择,结果KITTI Raw的组件为4个,ZOD和ONCE的组件均为8个. 在部署期间,产生的全球监测机制保持不变。

blocks.en: At runtime, each incoming batch is evaluated under the reference GMM to obtain a log-likelihood score. The resulting likelihood stream is monitored online by the Lepage Change Point Model (CPM), configured with ARL 0 = 10000 \mathrm{ARL}_{0}=10000 or ARL 0 = 20000 \mathrm{ARL}_{0}=20000 , which automatically determines the detection threshold corresponding to the desired average run length under nominal conditions.
blocks.zh: 在运行时,每批入场的批次都会在参考GMM下进行评估,以获得一个类似日志的分数. 由此产生的概率流由Lepage变换点模型(CPM)在线监测,配置为ARL 0 = 10000\mathrm{ ARL}_{0}=10000或ARL 0 = 20000\mathrm{ARL}_{0}=20000 自动确定在名义条件下对应于期望的平均运行长度的检测阈值.

blocks.en: Unless otherwise stated, the 3D–2D matching stage uses an IoU threshold of 0.1 0.1 , which was found to provide a good trade-off between retaining sufficient correspondences under moderate miscalibration and rejecting incorrect matches. Matches are additionally filtered using a truncation threshold τ t = 0.2 \tau_{t}=0.2 and a distance threshold τ d = 50 \tau_{d}=50 m (Section 4.3 ), discarding detections whose localization noise is expected to be large independently of calibration. All monitoring operations are implemented on the CPU and involve only geometric computations and GMM likelihood evaluations over low-dimensional feature vectors, resulting in negligible computational overhead with respect to the perception pipeline.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,3D–2D配对阶段使用0.10.1的IoU阈值,这被认为在中度校准下保留足够的函证和拒绝不正确的配对之间提供了良好的权衡. 火柴还采用截流阈值 τ t = 0.2\tau_{t}=0.2和距离阈值 τ d = 50\tau_{d}=50 m(第4.3节)进行过滤,丢弃其本地化噪声与校准无关的探测器. 所有监测业务均在CPU上进行,仅涉及几何计算和对低维特征矢量的GMM可能性评价,导致感知管道的计算间接费用微不足道。

blocks.en: Dataset details. KITTI Raw [ 6 ] provides 70 synchronized LiDAR–camera sequences acquired in urban, rural, and highway environments. Evaluation uses the 36 sequences with more than 350 frames; the remaining sequences are used for detector training and to construct 𝒮 r ​ e ​ f \mathcal{S}_{ref} . ZOD [ 1 ] provides both annotated single frames (ZOD Frames, used for detector training) and long driving sequences (ZOD Drives); ZOD Drives are further split into training drives, used to construct 𝒮 r ​ e ​ f \mathcal{S}_{ref} , and validation drives, used for evaluation. ONCE [ 12 ] contains LiDAR–camera driving sequences captured under diverse environmental conditions: detectors are trained on the training split, which also estimates the reference distribution ϕ 0 \phi_{0} , while evaluation is performed on the validation split.
blocks.zh: 数据集细节. KITTI Raw [6] 提供在城市、农村和高速公路环境中获得的70个同步LiDAR-camera序列。 评价使用超过350帧的36个序列;其余序列用于探测器训练以及构建S r e f\ mathcal{S}_{ref}. ZOD [1] 提供了附加说明的单帧(ZOD Frames,用于探测器训练)和长驱动序列(ZOD Drives); ZOD 驱动器进一步分为训练驱动器,用于构建S r e f\ mathcal{S}_{ref},以及用于评价的验证驱动器. ONCE [12] 包含在不同的环境条件下捕捉到的LiDAR-camera驱动序列:探测器在训练分解上接受训练,这也估计了参考分布 ^ 0\phi_{0},同时对验证分解进行评价.

blocks.en: Table 5 reports the complete results for the perturbation-magnitude study summarized in the main paper. While Table 3 reports FNR, FPR, and mean detection delay aggregated across perturbation magnitudes, here we analyze each perturbation level individually.

blocks.en: For each degree of freedom, we perturb only one calibration parameter at a time. Rotational perturbations are evaluated at 0.0125 0.0125 , 0.025 0.025 , and 0.05 0.05 rad, whereas translational perturbations are evaluated at 0.05 0.05 , 0.1 0.1 , and 0.2 0.2 m. For every configuration, we generate ten perturbed sequences by injecting the miscalibration at a random point in the sequence and evaluate MiCaDe using the protocol described in the main paper.

blocks.en: Overall, larger perturbations tend to be detected more quickly, since they induce greater changes in the monitored geometric consistency metrics and therefore require fewer observations before the sequential detector accumulates sufficient statistical evidence. This trend is particularly evident for pitch, t x t_{x} , and t z t_{z} , whose mean detection delay decreases substantially as the perturbation magnitude increases.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,较大的扰动往往能更快地被探测到,因为这些扰动导致监测到的几何一致性指标发生更大的变化,因此在相继探测器积累足够的统计证据之前,需要较少的观测. 这一趋势对投球,t x t_{x}和t z t_{z}尤其明显,其平均探测延迟随着扰动级的增大而大幅降低.

blocks.en: The relationship is, however, not strictly monotonic. For example, roll exhibits a slightly lower delay at 0.025 0.025 rad than at 0.05 0.05 rad, while the delay associated with the vertical translation t y t_{y} remains consistently high across all magnitudes. These fluctuations are expected because the detection delay depends not only on the perturbation magnitude, but also on scene content, the number and spatial distribution of matched objects, and the stochastic nature of the sequential change-detection process. Nevertheless, the overall trend confirms that MiCaDe becomes increasingly responsive as the severity of the calibration drift grows.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种关系并非严格意义上的单一关系。 例如,滚动显示的延迟度为0.025 0.025 rad,略低于0.05 0.05 rad,而纵向翻译 t y t _{y 的延迟度在所有规模上一直居高不下。 这些波动是预期的,因为探测延迟不仅取决于扰动幅度,还取决于场景内容,匹配物体的数量和空间分布,以及相继变化-探测过程的扭曲性. 然而,总体趋势证实,随着校准漂移的严重程度增加,MiCaDe反应能力越来越强。

blocks.en: B.2 Distribution of Detection Delays
blocks.zh: B.2 检测延迟的分布

blocks.en: In the main paper, detection delay is summarized using the mean delay over true-positive detections. However, the delay distribution is not symmetric: most calibration changes are detected quickly, while a smaller number of sequences require substantially longer observation windows before enough statistical evidence is accumulated. To better characterize this behaviour, Figure 6 reports the empirical distribution of detection delays on KITTI Raw.
blocks.zh: 在主论文中,检测延迟使用平均延迟而不是真实阳性检测进行总结. 然而,延迟分布并不对称:大多数校准变化被快速检测,而较少的序列则需要大大延长观测窗口,然后才能积累足够的统计证据. 为了更好地描述这种行为,图6报告了KITTI Raw上检测延迟的经验分布。

blocks.en: The histogram shows a strongly right-skewed distribution. The median delay is 7.61 7.61 s, meaning that half of the detected calibration changes are identified within a short temporal window. At the same time, the 90 90 th percentile is 19.11 19.11 s, indicating the presence of a long tail of more challenging cases extending up to several tens of seconds. These late detections typically correspond to sequences with fewer reliable 3D–2D correspondences, weaker projection shifts, or higher scene variability, where the sequential detector needs more batches before crossing the decision threshold.
blocks.zh: 直方图显示了强烈的右侧斜纹分布. 中位延迟为7.61 7.61 s,即检测到的校准变化有一半是在短时间窗口内识别出来的. 同时,90 90 百分位是19.11 19.11 s,表明存在一条较具挑战性的病例的长尾巴,可长达数十秒. 这些较晚的探测器一般对应可靠3D–2D通信较少的序列,投影偏移较弱,或场景变异性较高,相继探测器在跨越决定阈值前需要更多的批量.

blocks.en: The empirical cumulative distribution function further confirms this behaviour: the detection probability increases rapidly in the first seconds after the perturbation and then saturates more slowly due to the long-tail cases. This illustrates why a single mean-delay figure does not fully capture this behavior, and highlights the importance of reporting delay statistics beyond the average.
blocks.zh: 经验累积分布功能进一步证实了这一行为:在扰动后的第一秒,检测概率迅速增加,然后由于长尾病例,饱和度更加缓慢. 这说明了为什么一个单一的平均延迟数字不能完全反映这种行为,并突出了报告超出平均值的延迟统计的重要性.

blocks.en: B.3 Robustness to Scene Changes
blocks.zh: B.3 对场景变化的强烈性

blocks.en: We test whether a scene change, rather than a genuine calibration drift, can itself be mistaken for a persistent distributional shift. For each dataset, we concatenate pairs of clean sequences (A, B) and treat the concatenation point as a pseudo change point : calibration is correct on both sides, so an alarm attributed to it would indicate confusion between scene change and calibration drift. For each pair, ϕ 0 \phi_{0} is refit excluding both A and B, and MiCaDe runs with the standard operating point ( A ​ R ​ L 0 = 10000 ARL_{0}=10000 ). As a dataset-agnostic proxy for scene difference, we use object density (average frames needed to fill a batch), forming heterogeneous dense/sparse pairs against homogeneous control pairs of matching density, drawn from the same pool of sequences; where richer metadata is available, we also pair sequences by country/daypart (ZOD) and weather/daypart (ONCE, limited to very few pairs). The primary metric is the junction-FPR : the fraction of pairs with an alarm within ± 15 \pm 15 batches of the junction. FP/h, the global FPR, and the empirical A ​ R ​ L 0 ARL_{0} serve as secondary indicators of overall monitor stability, not specific to the junction.
blocks.zh: 我们检验一个场景的变化,而不是真正的校准漂移,本身是否可以被误认为是持续的分布性转变. 对于每个数据集,我们交配对的清洁序列(A,B),并将交配点作为伪变点处理 : 校准在两侧是正确的,因此归结的警报会表明场景变化和校准漂移之间的混淆. 每对, ^ 0\phi_{0} 正在重置, 不包括 A 和 B, 并且 MiCade 运行时有标准操作点( A R L 0 = 10000 ARL_{0}=10000 ) 。 作为场景差异的数据集不可知代词,我们使用对象密度(填充批次所需的平均框架),从同一个序列集合中抽取的匹配密度的均匀控制对形成异质的密度/sparse对;在有较丰富的元数据的情况下,我们也按国家/日区(ZOD)和天气/日区(ONCE,限制极少数对)进行配对. 主要的衡量标准是交叉点-FPR :在 ± 15\pm 15 批次内带警报的对数的分数. FP/h,全球FPR,以及实证AR L 0 ARL_{0}作为总体监测稳定性的次要指标,不特指交叉点.

blocks.en: B.4 Robustness of 2D–3D Matching under Miscalibration
blocks.zh: B.4 在校准错误下2D-3D匹配的强度

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 4.1 , the Bounding Box Matching procedure operates on projected 3D boxes, and is therefore itself affected by the calibration error it is meant to help monitor: a sufficiently large miscalibration could in principle produce wrong 2D–3D correspondences, which would corrupt the geometric consistency metrics and reduce detection power. We evaluate this effect directly using ground-truth object identities. For each match, we say it is accurate if the projected 3D detection and the 2D detection are associated with the same annotated object in both modalities; otherwise, the match is counted as an incorrect correspondence.
blocks.zh: 如第4.1节所述,Bonding Box配对程序在预测的3D箱上运作,因此本身受到它旨在帮助监测的校准误差的影响:足够大的校准误差原则上会产生错误的2D-3D通信,这将破坏几何一致性度量衡并降低检测功率. 我们直接用地面真实物体的身份来评估这个效果. 对于每个匹配,我们表示,如果投射的3D检测和2D检测与两种模式中相同的注解对象相关联,则准确;否则,匹配被算作不正确的对应.

blocks.en: We compare matching accuracy and the average number of retained matches per frame on ONCE, before and after an abrupt calibration change (Table 9 ). Matching accuracy decreases only marginally under miscalibration, showing that the assignment procedure remains largely reliable even after the calibration drift. The main effect of miscalibration is instead a reduction in the number of valid matches retained per frame, as fewer projected boxes reach the IoU threshold ρ \rho . Since MiCaDe accumulates evidence over batches rather than relying on any individual match, this reduction primarily lengthens the detection delay rather than the detection power, consistently with the results reported in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了在欧经委上,在突然校准变化之前和之后,每个帧的匹配精确度和保留匹配的平均数量(表9)。 匹配的准确性在校准错误的情况下只略微减少,这表明即使在校准漂移之后,转让程序在很大程度上仍然是可靠的。 校准错误的主要效果是每帧保留有效匹配的数量减少,因为预计的框数量减少,达到IoU阈值的值为 ^\rho 。 从 MiCaDe 分批积累证据,而不是依赖任何单个匹配,这种减少主要延长了检测延迟,而不是检测功率,这与第5节所报告的结果一致。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Effect of an abrupt calibration change on 2D–3D matching, on ONCE. Matching accuracy is only marginally affected, while the average number of retained matches per frame decreases.
blocks.zh: 表9:突然校准变化对2D-3D比对欧经委的影响。 匹配的准确性仅受到轻微影响,而每个帧保留匹配的平均数量减少。

Sensitivity remains good under moderate beam loss and either sector loss, but degrades markedly at only 8 of 64 rings (FNR 0.600 0.600 , FPR no longer zero); this rise in FNR is driven by the LiDAR object detector itself, which becomes less robust and produces fewer valid matches under such severe degradation, rather than by a failure of the monitoring scheme.

blocks.en: Take-away. Sensor degradation and calibration drift are largely distinguishable by MiCaDe: even a full 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} sector loss is never confused with miscalibration, and moderate beam loss does not compromise detection of a concurrent drift. Performance only degrades under severe beam loss, an effect bounded by the object detector’s own robustness to sparse input rather than by the monitoring scheme itself.
blocks.zh: 取经. 感光降解和校准漂移基本上可以被MiCaDe区分:甚至一个完整的90 ∘ 90 ^{\circ}扇区损失从不与校准错误混淆,中度光束损失不会影响同时漂移的探测. 性能只在严重梁损耗下降解,这种作用以物体探测器本身的坚固性与稀疏的输入,而不是监测计划本身为界。

blocks.en: The dataset contains approximately one hour of real urban driving, collected in residential and light-traffic areas. The vehicle follows a standard route including: straight roads, intersections, slow traffic segments, and mild accelerations/braking. This ensures diverse distributions of object distances, orientations, and occlusion patterns.
blocks.zh: 数据集包含约1小时的实际城市驾驶,收集于住宅区和轻便交通区. 车辆采用标准路线,包括:直路,交叉路口,慢行段,轻度加速度/刹车. 这确保了物体距离、方向和隔离模式的不同分布。

blocks.en: During the first half of the recording, all sensors are precisely calibrated, and the system is operated in nominal conditions. During the second half, we intentionally introduce a controlled misalignment on the front-left camera: • rotation of 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} in roll, 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} in pitch, and 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} in yaw; • no induced translation shift (only rotational perturbation), matching common real-world mechanical drift. The perturbation is physically introduced by loosening and rotating the camera mount before tightening it again. As a result, only rotational miscalibrations can be induced in a controlled and repeatable manner, whereas introducing a pure translational offset would require physically relocating the sensor and redesigning the mounting system. Once rotated, the camera remains rigidly fixed, so the induced drift is constant throughout the miscalibrated portion of the sequence.
blocks.zh: 在录制的前半期,所有传感器都精确校准,系统在名义上运行. 在下半场,我们有意在前左相机上引入一个有控制的错位: ^ 旋转 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 3 → yaw; ^ 没有诱导的翻译转换(仅旋转扰动),匹配常见的现实世界机械漂移. 扰动通过松动和旋转相机挂载进行物理引入,然后再次收紧. 因此,只能以可控和可重复的方式诱发旋转性误判,而采用纯翻译式抵消则需要实际迁移传感器和重新设计安装系统。 相机旋转后保持刚性固定,因此诱导的漂移在整个序列的误差部分是恒定的.

blocks.en: Appendix D Qualitative Change-Detection Examples
blocks.zh: 附录D 定性 变化检测示例

blocks.en: Figures 14 – 17 provide qualitative examples of MiCaDe on KITTI Raw, ZOD, and ONCE. Each example reports the temporal evolution of the monitored metrics before and after the injected calibration change, together with two representative image frames. Blue curves correspond to calibrated observations, orange curves to observations after the perturbation, the black dashed line marks the ground-truth change point, and the green dashed line indicates the alarm raised by MiCaDe. The bottom images show the geometric relationship between 2D detections (green boxes), projected 3D boxes (red dashed boxes), and the displacement vectors used to compute the monitored consistency metrics.
blocks.zh: 图14 - 17提供了KITTI Raw、ZOD和ONCE上的MiCaDe的质量例子。 每个例子都报告被监测的度量衡在注射校准变化前后的时间演变,以及两个具有代表性的图像框架。 蓝色曲线对应校准的观测,橙色曲线对应扰动后的观测,黑色破折线标志地面-真实变化点,绿色破折线表示米卡德提出的警报. 底部图像显示2D检测(绿色箱),投影3D箱(红色破碎箱)与用于计算被监控一致性度量的置换矢量之间的几何关系.

blocks.en: The true-positive examples in Figures 14 , 15 , and 16 show that calibration drift typically induces coherent changes across several metrics. In particular, the IoU decreases after the perturbation, while the displacement magnitude and center-offset components increase. Directional metrics also become more structured, reflecting the emergence of a preferred displacement direction between projected LiDAR boxes and image detections. These changes are visually consistent with the image examples, where the projected 3D boxes become systematically shifted with respect to the corresponding 2D detections after the perturbation.
blocks.zh: 图14、图15和图16中的真实阳性例子表明,校准漂移通常会导致若干指标的一致变化。 特别是,IoU在扰动后会减少,而流离失所的程度和中心抵消部分则会增加。 定向度量衡也变得更加结构化,反映了在预测的LiDAR盒和图像检测之间出现了偏好转移方向. 这些变化在视觉上与图像实例一致,其中预测的3D盒在扰动后会随着相应的2D探测而系统转移.

blocks.en: The examples also illustrate the difference between delay measured in batches and delay measured in frames. MiCaDe operates on batches of n = 15 n=15 matched detections, not on individual frames. Therefore, the conversion from batch delay to frame delay depends on how many valid 3D–2D correspondences are available in the scene. In dense scenes with many detected objects, batches are filled quickly and a small batch delay corresponds to only a few frames. This is visible in the ZOD example, where the change is detected in the same batch as the perturbation and corresponds to a delay of only 3 frames. Similarly, the KITTI example is detected after 1 batch, corresponding to 4 frames, while the ONCE true-positive example is detected after 4 batches, corresponding to 14 frames.
blocks.zh: 这些例子还说明了分批计量的延迟与帧计量的延迟之间的区别。 MiCaDe在批量的n = 15 n = 15匹配检测上运行,而不是在单个帧上运行. 因此,从批量延迟到帧延迟的转换取决于现场有多少有效的3D–2D通信可用. 在有许多被探测到的物体的密集场景中,批量迅速填充,一个小批量延迟只对应几个帧. 这在ZOD实例中可见,其中在扰动的同一批次中检测到变化,并且只对应3帧的延迟. 同样,KITTI例在1批之后检测,对应4帧,而ONCE真阳性例在4批之后检测,对应14帧.

blocks.en: Figure 17 shows a representative false-negative case on ONCE. In this sequence, the injected perturbation is very small: the rotational offsets are close to zero and the translations are below 0.1 0.1 m. As a consequence, the post-change metrics remain close to the variability observed during the calibrated portion of the sequence. The IoU, displacement magnitude, directional components, and depth error do not exhibit a persistent shift strong enough to separate the miscalibrated regime from nominal fluctuations. Visually, the projected 3D boxes remain only mildly misaligned with the 2D detections. This example highlights a natural limitation of object-level calibration monitoring: when the induced calibration drift is too small to produce a measurable change in geometric consistency, the sequential detector may not accumulate sufficient evidence to raise an alarm.
blocks.zh: 图17显示了欧经委上一个有代表性的假阴性案例。 在这个序列中,注射的扰动非常小:旋转偏移接近0,翻译低于0.1 m. 因此,变化后的衡量尺度仍然接近在序列的校准部分观察到的可变性。 IoU、迁移规模、方向部分和深度误差没有表现出持续变化的强烈程度,无法将误判的制度与名义波动分开。 在视觉上,投影的3D盒仅与2D探测器保持轻度误联. 这个例子突出了物体级校准监测的自然局限性:当诱导的校准漂移过小,无法产生几何一致性的可测量变化时,相继探测器可能无法积累足够的证据来引起警报.

blocks.en: Overall, these qualitative examples confirm the behaviour observed quantitatively in the main paper. MiCaDe detects calibration changes quickly when the perturbation produces a consistent geometric signature across matched detections, while failures mainly occur for very small perturbations whose effect is comparable to natural detection noise, scene variability, and matching uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些定性实例证实了在主要文件中在数量上观察到的行为。 MiCaDe在扰动在匹配的探测器之间产生一致的几何特征时探测到校准变化很快,而故障主要发生在非常小的扰动,其效果与自然探测噪声,场景变异,以及匹配的不确定性相当.
